notes.title: Remnants of the Rift 1.0 Out Now! 🦾
notes.notes:
It's the big day, Mercs! The 1.0 release day is finally here! We want to say a huge thank you to all our early access supporters over the last two years, we're so grateful for all your feedback throughout development and hope you're excited to dive back into the Bast.

Check out our launch trailer to see what's new:
[previewyoutube=KsgyQfgQeAs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Message from the developer:[/b]
Hello mercs,

It's been over five years since we embarked on the task to bring the Bast to you through Remnants of the Rift, and we are still dazzled that the day to finally release the game has come. Throughout this adventure, we've poured our vision and love for games, and we hope this reflects on the final product. Reaching this state for the game has only been possible thanks to Mooncat Games constant support throughout development. Their feedback and incredible ability to cheer us up during hard times have been paramount during the past few months before release.

We also want to thank all the players who joined us in the early access. Their comments helped us improve the game and consider the community's opinions. The game's current state differs vastly from the initial release thanks to the community's involvement.

We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed creating it. See you in the Bast!


[b]Will old saves still work?[/b]
Yes they should work fine! But we'd recommend starting a new save to experience the updates to the tutorial and new dialogue moments with Thomas and friends throughout the beginning of the game.

[b]Can I download the OST?[/b]
Yes! Our lovely friends at Controvol who designed the soundtrack for the game are releasing the soundtrack on [url=https://ditto.fm/remnants-of-the-rift-first-run-original-soundtrack]Ditto[/url] and adding more tracks over the next few days, but it'll also be available as DLC here on Steam, including unique album art. Stay tuned!

Remnants of the Rift is back with a new update! We've been working on some balancing lately, so, without further due, let's jump into what's new. 

First off, we've been balancing the difficulty of the game. There's something for everyone: from the beginner player trying to acclimate to the game, to the most seasoned mercenaries looking for a challenge. There are also updates to the enemies and bosses to keep combat fresh and interesting.

notes.title: Happy Pride Month from Bromio!
notes.notes:
One of the greatest joys of working on games is bringing all sorts of ideas to life, creating all kinds of worlds, characters, etc. 

Creating a diverse cast of characters is something we wished to do, as our team comes from all sorts of backgrounds. All of us at Bromio feel it's a disservice to deliver a homogeneous cast when there are so many options out there to choose from.

Since the Remnants of the Rift’s early days, we envisioned Morgan as a non-binary character simply for the reason we felt it would be a fun thing to do. Why should we necessarily do the usual brand of main character? Nothing stops us from doing something different, and it shouldn't stop anyone reading this to do so, either.

We felt the best way we could represent a non-binary character was to have them use any set of pronouns; that way, no matter what language the game is translated to, we can keep that aspect of Morgan clear.

We hope everyone enjoys and appreciates our small effort to represent a natural aspect of life.

Happy Pride, Everyone!

Bromio

notes.title: Introducing ROTR’s newest character, Rheem!
notes.notes:
Hey mercs,

We got another dimension-crossing transmission beaming onto your screens as we take a deeper dive into our newest character, Rheem! Who is he? What does he want with Morgan? And, most importantly, where did he find the inner strength to rock his mullet? Take a journey into The Bast today with us and learn more about Remnant of the Rift’s newest mercenary on the scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/44ed175a9e94e57ca1a667d07ae125839c2f4240.png[/img]

Rheem is a mercenary like Morgan, but without Morgan’s dazzling skills and a lack of Prana affinity which helps them with their abilities. While he struggles in his contracts because of these shortcomings, he does have one huge advantage over Morgan: his gift of gab. A librarian’s worst nightmare, Rheem has no qualm when it comes to sharing his thoughts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/b7d71f01e86124039e08f094b7abbe6135e01d01.png[/img]

So, what does this fast-talking merc want with Morgan? Well, they’re an Arms Dealer — literally! You encounter Rheem in The Bast the same way as Juno or the Twins after clearing a stage. At his “store”, you'll be able to switch all of your Mods in one of your Skills, kind of like a gamble in which you might get a better or worse loadout from what you were obtaining in the run. Don’t love your current Mods for your Prana Shot or Mine skill? Why not see what Rheem has up his sleeves 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/cbc1985a7dbc1f0ac92a10e3f8523bfaaebcba27.png[/img]

We debuted Rheem in our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1536711553?t=00h13m28s]stream[/url] last week where our Art Director, Colette, worked on his model which include painting over his nail, too! Gotta be glam if you want to be in our roguelike!

Thomas is one of Morgan’s oldest friends and even family, too! He was engaged with Morgan’s sister, Clark, in the past, but The Accident changed the trajectory of Morgan, Thomas, and Clark’s lives forever… 

After that dark episode, he became very close with Morgan. He works with the one of Remnants of the Rift’s Factions, V.I.S. but his second “job” is helping Morgan dive into The Bast to accomplish their contracts. Morgan is on the field in The Bast while Thomas provides intel and also built the Modulator that allows for Morgan to explore that alternate dimension.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/c2bebdcf8c03872b37a73eb6b70921e6a17bc7c1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/1a24b328a8d761e579aba8d4862ac83dd083e2e3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/9bb02b24988c01310f4dc10aa51a1ed7ec60f7e4.png[/img]

Hello there!

We’re back with another dev update, this time let’s ride a musical wave that will take us to the sounds of our game!

One of Remnants of the Rift’s key components is the game’s original soundtrack, so we wanted to take a deeper dive into the OST of the game and how music even influenced our character’s names, too!

[h1]Beats in The Bast[/h1]

While we’re fans of music at Bromio, and even ROTR’s lead character gets down with prog rock (like most nerds, right? I mean, Morgan is kind of nerdy…), the OST and sound design in the game is handled by Controvol. If you’ve followed our work from our previous games like Pato Box and Shiba Force, you may recognize their name as they’ve been helping us make our stuff sound that much cooler.

Here’s a sample of some of the audioscapes Controvol has planned for you:

[previewyoutube=EPVJOj-djfI;full][/previewyoutube]

Controvol is a group of musicians who are all into original music for video games, film, and art. You know, the very cool stuff, and they’re top-notch producers and composers who, from day one, really understood our vision for the world we were building. They were on board very early and their work has been just so outstanding that music has become a very important part of the identity of Remnants of the Rift. All instruments have been recorded so they react dynamically to what’s happening on-screen. The game wouldn’t be what it is without its groovy tunes!

The core team is formed by Alejandro Aspinwall, Gio Arenas, Fernando Vázquez de Lara and Luis Vázquez de Lara. Each member takes part in the creative process, adding their unique styles into each composition and supporting in several key roles. Alejandro specializes in audio supervision, sound design, and spearheads audio integration and music production. Gio is the lead recording artist, specializing in music and sound production, design and integration. Fernando has been in the forefront of the creative identity and branding processes of Controvol since its inception, and Luis specializes in music supervision, responsible for marketing and project management.

At the heart of Controvol lies its philosophy of collaborating with other artists. Fernando Harada is the guest artist in charge of blasting and bringing the soundtrack’s drum recordings to life. He is a versatile musician with a specialized background in rock and jazz; a professional session drummer, recording artist, live performer and composer. Dedicated to intricate rhythm patterns and thoughtful musical experimentation, each drum track was meticulously recorded by Fernando using multiple interpretations and variations so that (alongside with the rest of the instruments) they could react dynamically to the gameplay.

notes.title: Say Hi to Remnants of the Rift!
notes.notes:
Hello again mercs,

Our first 👀 big news item this month…RFM is dead, and like a phoenix rising from the ashes, Remnants of the Rift was born! That's right, our retrofuture roguelike with tons of heart and a musical soul has a brand new name, and, oh, is that a brand new teaser trailer for you? Check it out!!!

[previewyoutube=gT29NERBEsA;full][/previewyoutube]

Changing our game’s title was not made on a whim as we held quite a few meetings over Discord across multiple timezones to find a new name we loved. As indie game devs, we certainly know how critical a game’s name can be to helping break through the noise, and, while RFM will always be dear to our hearts, we feel it didn’t immediately tell new fans what our game was about. It was both a commercial and creative choice as we also wanted a name that better resonated with the game’s story. And so, we salute RFM as it ascends to the place where No Truce With The Furies and Secret Legend roam.

It would mean the world to us if you sign up to get notifications of our upcoming Kickstarter below, and please do share with your friends too:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1548341006/rfm-a-strategic-roguelike-where-time-is-on-your-side


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/2cf3e414381a25bc1e818e54ab463c3031947326.png[/img]
[i]New name, same retrofuturistic roguelike.[/i]

The name Remnants of the Rift touches on a core theme running through the game: living with the past with all of its phantom pain and leftover love. Our protagonist Morgan and those around them have a profound understanding of this feeling after an accident stole someone dear to them. The new name better reflects the narrative and world we have crafted for you. Before landing on Remnants of the Rift, we may have spent a few too many hours discussing and deliberating over possible alternatives, here’s a look at what could have been:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/1b9846ad67e7eaa35f86c9887dfe0cddeace5188.png[/img]
[i]Say my name, say my name, say my name 🎶[/i]

RFM is no more, long live Remnants of the Rift. We like this new name, and we hope you do as well.

Stay good wherever you are,

Bromio Team

notes.title: Who is Morgan? Introducing the protagonist of our roguelike adventure
notes.notes:
Hello mercenaries!

There is no story without characters, so we want to take a deep dive into RFM’s protagonist, Morgan! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/e2b699398624ccb2d761f7de16e4224114120de4.png[/img]

In a world thriving in a golden age of technology, there’s still good coin to be made in The Bast. The Bast is a rogue (ha!) portal dimension that nebulously links Morgan’s world to a third dimension where the Megin reside. It is a place rife with danger and loot! The arrival of The Bast has birthed a valuable energy resource called Prana for both human and Megini dimensions alike. Someone’s got to venture into The Bast to gather Prana while fighting off Megin, and that’s where Morgan comes in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/18ab32608492556b061f55793ea28440f97ca505.gif[/img]

As you might have noticed, Morgan doesn’t need to worry about leg day with their mechanical limbs. "An upcoming mercenary, Morgan's got gunplay and strategies that are second to none, with their skill it won't be long before they get the next contract from the multiple factions vying for Prana in The Bast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/3748d4caeeeabe821f2ae25686d1672ad702b90d.jpg[/img]

Thankfully, Morgan doesn’t have to go at it alone. Their best friend, Thomas, is a tech wunderkind who provides navigational intel for The Bast which is supremely useful for any new contact Morgan takes on. Juno, a friendly and curious Megini, lends her skills in tinkering by modding Morgan’s mechanical limbs and tools. As Morgan continues to explore The Bast, they’ll find loot aplenty, but also answers to finding a person very dear to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/11044dbb52a9abd39e02eeec3b7b105495fa92d1.png[/img]

But, that’s a story for another day…

For today, however, here is a peek at a new look for Morgan’s in-game character portrait! Our talented artist, Colette, worked on refining some of the character looks. Morgan is looking as dapper as ever with those suspenders as they go for another run in The Bast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/3f80395c83fa3b63c2dedddd9429813f31950667.gif[/img]

Aside from our fave merc, Thomas is also sporting a new beard which gives him an impressive boon to style, but unfortunately, a new weakness when having soup!

The final Morgan tidbit today is a fun fact: Morgan’s favourite music is prog rock! Long runs in The Bast suit some of the longer songs you can find in the genre, or so they say. Perhaps they’d wear a nice pair of headphones at some point while battling?

Stay tuned for more updates as we prepare deeper looks into RFM and its world!

We have a Discord server for RFM and all our games where we occasionally share some behind the scenes stuff and always answer your questions: https://discord.gg/Bromio

Thank you, mercs.


Bromio
